title: verbascum × adulterinum subsp. seminigrum
intro: Verbascum × adulterinum subsp. seminigrum, commonly known as the Dark Mullein, is a subspecies of a flowering plant native to Europe and North Africa. The Dark Mullein has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe coughs and relieve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to reduce inflammation and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Dark Mullein include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional herbal medicine.
